name: pii-filter
description: Automatic, local PII filtering with Microsoft Presidio (Dutch + English): reading a data file with personal data gives Claude a pseudonymised copy (<PERSON_1>, <NL_BSN_1>, ...), raw shell/Grep views of data files are blocked, and the local vault with real values stays off-limits. Works for subagents too. Code files are never touched, so development continues as normal.
